data.title: Training data for a menu recommendation AI

message.text: This AI suggests menu items in the app based on order history.

notes.text: No names, phone numbers or addresses; only menu history.
Customers agreed to this use in the app terms of service.

explanation: The data is anonymous, balanced across cities, and covered by consent in the terms of service. Safe to approve.
hints: Check three things: personal data, balance, and consent.
If it's all fine, there's no need to hold it back.
